subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about funded-account acquisition for {Brand}. With the CFTC signaling US perpetual futures approval and Kraken and Coinbase racing to launch domestic perps in 2026, a fresh wave of US deposit demand is opening, and that is where acquisition cost gets decided: a centralized-exchange funded customer runs near $150 all-in, while click-to-deposit lands at just 0.3 to 0.8 percent. We optimize to the cleared deposit and measure it against a holdout, so paid depositors show as incremental to your organic traders. Worth comparing against your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: US perpetual-futures rule change (sourced) + ~$150 funded-customer CAC band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN crypto_and_trading: acknowledges 2nd follow-up + references prior email; fresh angle = timely development (CFTC US perpetual-futures approval signal + Kraken/Coinbase domestic perps race, 2026, bnnbloomberg) anchored to market band (centralized-exchange funded customer ~$150 all-in, growthchain 2025; click-to-deposit 0.3-0.8%, hypelab 2026); market context is real and web-verified with URLs in enrichment_sources; no MobUpps figure this stage (holdout/incrementality referenced without a number); reuses only parent brands (Coinbase, Kraken); native EN register; 1 question mark; no sign-off; no em-dash; no X-not-Y.
